website_metadata.notes: Natixis CIB opened its GIFT City IBU branch on 2026-05-01. It offers foreign-currency-denominated structured products and finance (energy & commodities, infrastructure, aviation, export financing, ECB) to corporate and institutional clients only. No deposit product and no published rate table. Wholesale-only IBU.

warnings: Branch is very new (opened May 2026); corporate/investment-banking focus, no retail deposits.
